test.create_query: CREATE TABLE set_tuple_ids (id Tuple(UInt64, LowCardinality(UUID)), v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY v
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO set_tuple_ids SELECT (k, reinterpretAsUUID(sipHash128(k % 1000))), number FROM (SELECT number, intHash64(number) % 1000000 AS k FROM numbers_mt(20000000))
test.query: SELECT count() FROM set_tuple_ids WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM set_tuple_ids WHERE v < 1000000)
SELECT count() FROM set_tuple_ids WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM set_tuple_ids WHERE v < 10000)
SELECT count() FROM set_tuple_ids WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM set_tuple_ids WHERE v < 10000)
SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(20000000) WHERE (toUInt32(intHash32(number) % 2000000), toUInt8(number % 7)) IN (SELECT (toUInt32(number), toUInt8(number % 7)) FROM numbers(1000000))
